reddit.title: Improved Music Experience in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made a significant upgrade to the music system in Provincia! Now, when transitioning between day, night, title, and combat beds, you'll experience a smooth audio transition instead of a jarring cut. This long equal-power self-crossfade ensures a seamless listening experience, even during intense gameplay moments. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
